title: Has anyone been in the tunnels of mallworld?
content: I dreamt of these tunnels in the mall for street vendors, they are busy and crowded. They had a circus tent like feel to them. Little shop stands line the sides, and there are hallways to connect back to shopping. The ceiling is really low, and its very cozy and tight quarters inside. The image doesnt totally capture what I dreamt, but as close as I can get.
